task.goal: Write one Article and machine-parseable INTAKE from the supplied evidence

task.approach: Investigation approach: distinguish what the supplied record establishes from what it does not. Follow the unresolved gap fairly; no invented response, silence, or accusation.
task.runningStoriesNote: signal.runningStories are events the city is already living through and where each one stands. Background only — write nothing about tracking them.

limits.rule: The manifest is exhaustive for load-bearing canon claims. Persona-authorized texture may create lived street color only inside manifest.authorizedTexture and manifest.textureConditions; it never proves a canon fact. No citizen spoke for this piece: manifest.approvedQuotes is empty. Write no quoted speech and attribute no statement to any person; the piece stands on the record and the place.

intake.heading: ## INTAKE
lines: NAMES: <one citizen name> | <quoted-source OR subject OR mentioned>
BIZ: <one business/org name> | <quoted-source OR subject OR mentioned>
STORYLINE: <short-kebab-case-slug> | <advanced OR opened OR closed OR referenced>

output.rule: Article shape is assigned-fact lede, one scene, one Packet quote, unanswered question. Scene may be the supplied field or box score; it must not mint a room, access, dialogue, or count absent from this Packet. Index only what the Article prints. Repeat NAMES/BIZ/HOOD/CLAIM lines for multiple records. Every CLAIM must point to one supplied src.

reviewProfile.purpose: Separate what the Packet establishes from what remains open, pursue the accountable record fairly, and make a documented contradiction or documented silence visible without inventing either.

articleContract.voice: evidence-first; concise records brief without reporting events, full investigation only with a Packet-backed reporting trail
articleContract.targetWords: 180-280 without reporting events; 450-750 with Packet-backed reporting events
articleContract.opening: the strongest Packet-backed fact followed by the unresolved question
articleContract.closing: the next record or answer still needed; name a responsible office only when supplied

authorizedTexture: the reporter's own act of reading, comparing, requesting, or following a record only when that act is supplied by the Packet
a concise known-versus-unknown structure over Packet-backed facts and declared missing fields
fair pressure framed as a question, interpretation, or explicit request for a record
short transitions between supplied facts that add no event, response, duration, source, or accusation
textureConditions: every named person, office, institution, Project, Initiative, business, organization, quote, response, request, and document must come from the Packet
a silence clock requires a Packet-backed request or response event and a supplied duration or Cycle span; otherwise its state is unestablished
decline-to-comment, no-response, refusal, contradiction, and responsible-office claims must each have a supplied source
an open question must remain a question and must not imply criminality, misconduct, duty, motive, or official knowledge absent from the Packet
canonBlockers: an invented records request, interview attempt, response, refusal, decline-to-comment, document, source, or silence duration
an unsupported contradiction, official duty, responsible office, act, inaction, promise, decision, motive, accusation, or finding
a named person, office, institution, Project, Initiative, business, or organization not found in the supplied record
a number, date, duration, budget, metric, count, vote, or timeline that contradicts or lacks the supplied record
Jax-style theatrical heat that turns an unestablished lead into a settled factual claim
